rows.grounds: compound: deva (divine) + kalyāṇa (auspicious-rite), locative of place/occasion

items.question: Can an auspicious act performed in a divine rite remain imperishable?
premises: An auspicious act may be performed in a divine auspicious rite.
The particles ca and api extend perishing even to such an act.
The verb vinaśyati asserts that this act perishes.
items.inference: Even an auspicious act performed in a divine rite is subject to perishing.
uncertainties: The precise referent of kalyāṇam (ritual act or its merit) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Even an auspicious act performed in a divine auspicious rite perishes.
